description: config.Load(lookup) cases. Each case: env map passed as the lookup (a key absent from env = unset). ok=true -> config holds the parsed values (durations in seconds; capture_master_key_hex is the decoded 32 bytes re-encoded lowercase). ok=false -> issues is the exact ordered Issue list and error_text the exact Error() string. Cases with go_test empty are extra probes of observed Go behavior, not Go tests; they are still parity targets. The Go tests themselves only assert substrings (var name in error text) and specific fields; the full values here were captured by running the Go code.
